{{PSX|Titanic Pets}}
'''Titanic Pets''' are a type of [[List of Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|pet]] in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. They are larger than [[Huge Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|huge]] pets in both size and power, are 3x stronger than the player's best pets, and ridable.
* '''Golden Titanic Pets''' deal '''+1.2 times''' more damage than '''Normal Titanic Pets.'''
* '''Rainbow Titanic Pets''' deal '''+3.6 times''' more damage than '''Normal Titanic Pets.'''
* '''Shiny Titanic Pets''' deal '''+4 times''' more damage than '''Normal Titanic Pets.'''
In the inventory, their icons are larger (about the same size as 4 normal pets), and have a crown symbol instead of stars, unlike other pets. In the inventory, they appear above all pets except [[Gargantuan Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|gargantuan pets]].

These pets '''always''' have the {{Exclusive99}} rarity in-game, as well as stats represented by 4 question marks.
